snippet.title: Forgotlings | Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Our new release date trailer is here! We are happy to announce Forgotlings will release 17th of February 2026.

Forgotlings is a cinematic story-driven action-adventure set in a magical realm inhabited by sentient forgotten objects. You'll play as Fig, a once-forgotten posing doll now captain of the sentient lightship Volare. As shadows stir and ancient divisions crack the land, you must soar across windswept skies and forgotten cities, uniting warring tribes before everything unravels.

🎮 Play Forgotlings demo now & Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2059570/Forgotlings/

✨ Learn more about Forgotlings:
https://www.throughlinegames.com/forgotlings

💬 Join our Discord server:
https://discord.gg/kYBN8B2YhJ

📣 Keep up-to-date with the latest news on Forgotlings via our socials:
X/Twitter: https://x.com/ThroughlineGame
